name: Intersectional-Bias-Assessment-(Testing-Data)
description:
This synthetic dataset contains demographic and clinical data used to test the
performance of a trained classifier in predicting a diagnosis (of schizophrenia
or depression), and assess performance for intersectional bias.

This dataset is used in the tutorial 'An Intersectional Approach to Model
Construction and Evaluation in Mental Health Care' presented at ACM FAccT 2022.
creator: Marta Maslej
citation: Maslej, M., Sikstrom, L., Reslan, D., Wang, Y.
